data.completion_memo: Implemented typed semantic activity-card normalization for messages, plans, model/tool/MCP/plugin/subagent/external-agent/artifact/approval/route/error/verification/repair items. Rich content is escaped, reasoning labels remain source-provided, unknown records remain inspectable, actions are converted only to typed gateway intents, and a bounded virtual timeline window avoids whole-history rendering.
data.description: Implement virtualized rendering for messages and typed plan, model, tool, MCP, plugin, subagent, external-agent, artifact, approval, route, error, verification, and repair items. Sanitize rich content, preserve source-supplied reasoning categories, render unknown items as escaped inspectable data, and emit only typed actions.
